description: Mark an order done: its state moves to closed. Payment, fulfillment, items and money do not change. With autoCloseOrders on (update_cart_config, on by default) an order closes by itself once it is paid and fulfilled; a closed order reopens by itself if it later stops being paid or fulfilled. An order already closed is left as it is. Refused for a canceled order. reopen_order undoes it; cancel_order is a different, final step. Returns the order's id and orderNumber.
name: close_order
title: Close order
